data.name: Galactic Conflict
data.detailed_description:
🚀 Galactic Conflict

Command your empire in a real-time 4X strategy experience where every decision shapes the fate of the galaxy.

Expand across star systems, exploit resources, build powerful fleets, and wage war against rival AI empires in a constantly evolving battlefield. Whether you dominate through expansion, strategy, or overwhelming force, only one empire will control the galaxy.

🌌 Expand, Explore, Exploit, Exterminate

  • Explore procedurally generated star systems filled with planets, moons, and asteroid fields

  • Expand your empire by claiming territory and securing strategic locations

  • Exploit resources to fuel your economy, fleet production, and expansion

  • Exterminate rival AI empires through real-time combat and tactical decision-making

⚔️ Real-Time Strategy at Scale

Engage in fast-paced, real-time warfare across multiple star systems.

  • Command fleets in active combat zones

  • Fight simultaneous battles across different systems

  • Balance offense, defense, and expansion under constant pressure

  • React to evolving threats from multiple AI factions

Victory depends on your ability to think ahead, adapt quickly, and manage your empire efficiently.

🧠 Strategic Empire Management

Build and maintain a growing interstellar empire.

  • Manage resources and production

  • Control fleet creation and deployment

  • Expand intelligently to avoid overextension

  • Optimize your strategy based on galaxy size and AI difficulty

Every choice matters — one mistake can cost you entire systems.

🌠 Dynamic Galaxy Simulation

The galaxy evolves whether you're watching it or not.

  • AI empires expand, build, and wage war independently

  • Conflicts continue across systems even when you're not present

  • Large-scale wars unfold dynamically across the map

You are not the only force shaping the galaxy.

🔥 Multiple Difficulty Levels

Challenge yourself against increasingly aggressive AI empires.

  • Normal – Balanced for strategic growth

  • Hard – Faster AI expansion and stronger pressure

  • Insane – Relentless AI with minimal resource limitations

Only the most efficient and ruthless strategies will survive at higher difficulties.

💾 Persistent Progression

  • Save and load your empire at any time

  • Build long-term strategies across extended play sessions

  • Compete for high scores based on performance and difficulty

🎯 Designed for Strategy Players

Galactic Conflict is built for players who enjoy:

  • 4X and grand strategy games

  • Real-time decision making with long-term consequences

  • Managing complex systems under pressure

  • Expanding and controlling large-scale empires

👑 Will You Conquer the Galaxy?

Every system you claim, every fleet you build, and every war you fight brings you closer to total domination — or total collapse.

The galaxy will not wait.
Your enemies will not hesitate.

Adapt. Expand. Conquer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS Version: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse with wheel required. Designed for 1280×720 resolution or higher.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU recommended for smoother performance
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse with wheel required. Designed for 1280×720 resolution or higher.
